ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central vertical low-intensity band extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Contiguous high-intensity regions dominate the medial areas of both lobes. High-intensity areas are bordered by low-intensity margins, with significant dark mottling and focal spotting in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants near the fluke base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 50-60 degrees with a moderate depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the trailing edge; the edge is relatively smooth with subtle, irregular scalloping visible against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep along the trailing edges, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curving tips (flukes are oriented in a high-fluking position).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately 15% of the distance from the tip toward the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast pigment 'bridge' of dark pixels connecting the central peduncle stalk to the lower trailing edge of the right lobe.
